raw:
Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 5
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner abruptly pivoted from the correct hypothesis (coal-burning factories, option C) to instructing the WebSurfer to gather evidence to “validate” option B (hydroelectric power plants), even invoking reservoir-induced acidity. This misdirection contradicted earlier correct reasoning about acid rain from SO2/NOx (primarily from coal combustion) lowering lake pH in the Northeast and set the process on a path to the wrong answer.
